title: How to Use Google My Business for Your Coffee Shop: A Step-by-Step Guide | Per Diem

facts.fact: Google verifies a business listing before it goes live, usually by mailing a postcard with a code to the business address, though some businesses can verify by phone or email.
facts.quote: Google will ask you to verify your coffee shop before your listing goes live. This usually involves receiving a postcard with a code to your business address

facts.fact: Per Diem states that Think Coffee, an independent coffee brand, has thousands of app downloads after placing its app download link in its Google profile.
facts.quote: They now have thousands of downloads and regular app-based orders that come in daily.

facts.fact: Per Diem recommends choosing the 'Coffee shop' category or a related term rather than a broad category such as 'Restaurant' when setting up a Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: Choose “Coffee shop” or a related term, rather than something too broad like “Restaurant.”

facts.fact: Google allows users to message businesses directly through their Google Business Profile listings.
facts.quote: Google allows users to message businesses directly through their listings.

facts.fact: The Per Diem guide was published on June 19, 2025.
The page states that without verifying a Google Business Profile listing, updates will not show up publicly and customers may not find the business.
facts.quote: Without [verification](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242?hl=en), your updates won’t show up publicly and customers may not find you at all.

facts.fact: The page states that leaving hours, categories, or the business description blank can limit a coffee shop's visibility in searches.
facts.quote: Skipping things like hours, categories, or the business description can limit your visibility in searches.

facts.fact: The page recommends that coffee shops answer common questions in the profile's Q&A section proactively, such as whether they offer free Wi-Fi, dairy-free options, or dogs on the patio.
facts.quote: It’s smart to answer common ones proactively, such as whether you offer free Wi-Fi, have dairy-free options, or allow dogs on the patio.
